en.name: Boniface III
en.summary: A pope whose brief reign secured from the emperor Phocas a formal recognition of Rome as head of all the churches.
en.body: Boniface III, who had earlier served as a papal representative in Constantinople, obtained from the emperor Phocas a decree explicitly affirming the bishop of Rome's title as head of all Christian churches, a recognition aimed partly at curbing the rival claims of the Patriarch of Constantinople to the title 'ecumenical.' He held office for less than a year before his death.
